sub_graphs.title: EIP-197: Pairing Input Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the input validation process for the bn128 pairing precompile

nodes.label: Pairing Input Received
nodes.description: Raw input bytes received by precompile at address 0x8

nodes.label: Validate Input Length
nodes.description: Check that input length is a multiple of 192 bytes (96 bytes per G1+G2 pair)

nodes.label: Input Length Invalid
nodes.description: Input length not divisible by 192 - execution will revert

nodes.label: Input Length Valid
nodes.description: Input length passes basic format check

nodes.label: Decode Point Pairs
nodes.description: Parse k pairs of (G1, G2) points from input bytes

nodes.label: Validate G1 Point Encoding
nodes.description: Verify G1 coordinates are < p and satisfy curve equation Y² = X³ + 3 or are (0,0)

nodes.label: Validate G2 Point Encoding
nodes.description: Verify G2 coordinates in F_p² are valid and point has order q

nodes.label: Point Encoding Invalid
nodes.description: At least one point fails encoding validation - execution reverts

nodes.label: All Points Valid
nodes.description: All k point pairs pass validation checks

edges.label: Coordinate >= p or not on curve

external_entities.name: EVM Contract Caller
external_entities.description: Smart contract or EOA that calls the pairing precompile via CALL opcode

sub_graphs.title: EIP-197: Pairing Computation State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the mathematical pairing verification computation

nodes.label: Points Validated
nodes.description: All k point pairs have passed validation

nodes.label: Compute Optimal Ate Pairings
nodes.description: Compute e(a_i, b_i) for each pair using optimal ate pairing on alt_bn128

nodes.label: Multiply Pairing Results
nodes.description: Compute product e(a1,b1) * e(a2,b2) * ... * e(ak,bk) in F_q^12

nodes.label: Check Product Equals Identity
nodes.description: Verify if the product equals 1 in the target field

nodes.label: Pairing Verification Succeeded
nodes.description: Product equals identity - return 1 (32-byte big-endian)

nodes.label: Pairing Verification Failed
nodes.description: Product does not equal identity - return 0 (32-byte big-endian)

nodes.label: Empty Input Case
nodes.description: Input is empty (k=0) - trivially returns 1

sub_graphs.title: EIP-197: Pairing Gas Cost Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas metering for the pairing precompile

nodes.label: Precompile Call Initiated
nodes.description: Call to address 0x8 initiated, gas cost must be determined

nodes.label: Count Point Pairs
nodes.description: Calculate k = input_length / 192

nodes.label: Compute Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas = 80000 * k + 100000

nodes.label: Deduct Gas From Caller
nodes.description: Subtract computed gas from available gas

nodes.label: Insufficient Gas
nodes.description: Caller did not provide enough gas - out of gas error

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Deducted
nodes.description: Gas payment successful, proceed with computation

ambiguities.text: The specification states G2 points must have 'order equal to q' but doesn't specify how implementations should verify this efficiently.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations use cofactor multiplication or subgroup membership checks. Verification method should be explicitly specified for security.

ambiguities.text: The behavior when input contains the point at infinity mixed with regular points is not explicitly detailed.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume point at infinity (0,0) encoding is valid for G1 and treated as the identity element in pairing computation. Pairing with infinity should yield 1 in target field.

ambiguities.text: The terms 'fails' and 'reverts' are used - unclear if this means return empty/zero or actual EVM revert.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'fails' means the precompile reverts (consumes all gas, returns nothing), consistent with other precompile behavior on invalid input.

implicit_assumptions.description: The implementation of the optimal ate pairing is mathematically correct and matches the specification's algebraic definition.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect pairing implementation could allow invalid zkSNARK proofs to verify, breaking zero-knowledge proof systems.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot find points that pass encoding validation but have incorrect subgroup membership.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Subgroup attacks could allow forged pairing results, compromising cryptographic protocols built on this precompile.

implicit_assumptions.description: The alt_bn128 curve parameters (p, q, generators) are correctly hardcoded in all client implementations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Parameter mismatches between clients could cause consensus failures or invalid proof acceptance.
